changelog: Smart Notch comes back on its own when a monitor reconnects, after sleep, or when Windows starts without a display ready.
If the notch stops responding, it now recovers by itself instead of closing.
The volume pop-up no longer says sound is playing on your phone or another Bluetooth device when it is coming from your speakers.
Old startup entries left by earlier versions are cleaned up. If an older copy of Smart Notch still starts with Windows, you get a one-time tip to turn it off.
Background helpers restart more gently and stay stopped when you quit.
Crash reports explain more about what happened, so problems get fixed faster. Nothing is sent unless you press Send.
Join the Smart Notch community on Discord, right from the Settings sidebar.
